text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a maelstrom of fervor and excitement, the curtain falls on the Twinkle Star Climax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the spectators are celebrating the emergence of the greatest racer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Reporter Otonashi also takes the opportunity to express her deep gratitude for all my help in making the event a reality!
